server.description: Core LCDProc server configuration: network binding, logging, privileges, and runtime behavior.

host.description: IP address to bind the server to. Use 0.0.0.0 to listen on all interfaces.

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file used by the daemon.

user.description: Unix user to drop privileges to after startup. Leave empty to keep root.

group.description: Unix group to drop privileges to after startup. Leave empty to keep root.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging. 0 = no logs, 9 = debug. Recommended: 2–3 for production.

log_file.description: Path to log file. Leave empty to log to stderr.

background.description: Run the server as a background daemon.

idle_timeout.description: Seconds to wait after last client disconnect before shutting down the LCD. 0 = never shut down.

font.description: Default font name (must exist in FontPath).

font_path.description: List of directories (colon-separated) where fonts are stored.

drivers.description: Ordered list of LCD drivers to load. Each driver has its own config block.

name.description: Driver name (e.g., hd44780, I2C, serial, sdl).

path.description: Optional explicit path to driver module (e.g., '/usr/lib/lcddriver/hd44780.so'). If empty, auto-resolved.

lcd_model.description: Model name of the LCD device (used by some drivers like hd44780).

lcd_backlight.description: Turn backlight on by default (driver-specific; only used if supported).

lcd_voltage.description: Supply voltage in millivolts (e.g., 5000 for 5V). Driver-specific.

lcd_delay.description: Delay in microseconds between operations. Adjust for slow hardware.
